title: Nano Banana Pro can generate 4K images
summary:
4K Nano Banana Pro images, more flexible chat inputs, and fewer balance-check round trips.

Nano Banana Pro now selects 1K, 2K, or 4K output based on the requested pixel count and maps dimensions to the closest supported aspect ratio. Its default side length also increased from 1024 to 2048 pixels.

The chat API now accepts content-part arrays beyond user messages, including document file parts and Anthropic cache controls. Streaming errors preserve upstream HTTP statuses, and `max_tokens` works with newer Azure OpenAI models. Five Claude configurations also moved to a native Bedrock provider connection.

Enter now tracks meter balances locally for five minutes and updates the cached balance after billable requests. That means fewer balance-check calls and less chance of a request running into the balance provider’s API limits.

daily.text: Generate images with `nanobanana-pro` at up to 4K resolution. Its default side length is now 2048 pixels. [Explore the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nanobanana-pro).
